# Kit tools provenance

Each tool below is a byte-identical copy of the Factory's own `tools/<name>`, so a project using this
kit runs the exact same checks the Factory runs on itself. Hashes are sha256 of LF-normalized content
(CRLF collapsed to LF before hashing), so a Windows checkout and a Linux checkout hash equal. Regenerate
with `python tools/generate_kit_tools_provenance.py` whenever a source tool changes; CI runs it with
`--check` so a stale copy never merges.
